incidentWindow.description: Synthetic client ramp reaches peak load, followed by CPU and heap pressure and a locally concentrated warning/error sequence.

expectedCorrelations.description: Concurrent clients rise from 10 to 120 before CPU crosses 80 percent and heap crosses 750000000 bytes.
Peak pressure overlaps the checked-in queue-worker warning, checkout-queue error, and database warning.
Clients, CPU, and heap all decline after the peak; the fixture asserts correlation only, not causation.

safety: Expected answers live outside both import/ and metrics/. Product context may include imported measurements and their provenance, but never this evaluator truth.
